title: Tristacher See Lienz
highlights: East Tyrol's only natural swimming lake at the foot of the Lienz Dolomites
Refreshing lido with expansive lawn areas and beach volleyball court
Picturesque circular hiking trail through fragrant spruce forests
Imposing limestone faces of the Lienz Dolomites reflected in the clear water
kurzbeschreibung: Tristacher See near Lienz is the only bathing lake in Osttirol and captivates with its setting beneath the Lienzer Dolomiten.
beschreibung:
Natural Bathing Jewel at the Foot of the Dolomites

The Tristacher See lies idyllically on the southern slope of the Lienz basin at 821 meters above sea level. As the only natural bathing lake in Osttirol, it attracts sun seekers, swimmers, and nature enthusiasts with water temperatures reaching up to 24 degrees Celsius.

Recreation Area for Young and Old

The municipal lido offers extensive sunbathing lawns, a diving tower, children's playgrounds, and a café. Along the pristine lakeside circular path, visitors can take a relaxing stroll through the shady mixed forest while enjoying views of the rugged Dolomite peaks reflected in the crystal-clear water.
